subject: convoyHauler
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: armoured convoy hauler guarding a sealed cargo pod.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk.
reasoning:
I'm planning a static six-wheel armoured truck model with a front cab, rear cargo pod, neon trim accents, and SVG-based textures for warning stripes, emblem, hazard markings, and headlights, focusing on getting the dimensions and part structure right.

I'm sketching out the chassis dimensions and helper geometry functions, applying colors from the clockwork and glow kits, planning five SVG textures, and working out wheel placement with tires, rims, hubs, axles, and lug nuts positioned across three axle rows.

Now I'm laying out the body: a chassis beam, a cab box with proportions for width, height and depth, a lower hood section, a sloped windshield plane with a cyan glow texture, armour visor slits, a light bar, antenna, roll bar, and a front bumper ram shape.

I'm adding glowing headlight boxes on the hood front and a vented grille texture, then figuring out the cargo pod shape -- considering a tapered loft between two profile stations versus a simpler stack of boxes with bevel plates and a sealed lid ring.

Now I'm layering escort details: armour skirts, cylindrical fuel tanks, exhaust stacks, a roof turret with rotated barrel cylinders, magenta underglow strips, hazard-texture side plates, and a "SEALED / CARGO 07" label plane oriented so the text reads correctly from the +X viewing side.

Writing wheel and fender helper functions...

Finishing up the component with metadata and the default export.
